name: droid-external-models
description: Use your own model providers in Factory Droid. Add your API keys and tick the models you want.

scripts.build: bun build --compile src/cli.ts --outfile dist/droid-models; status=$?; rm -f .*.bun-build; exit $status
scripts.install-local: bun run build && mkdir -p ~/.local/bin && cp dist/droid-models ~/.local/bin/.droid-models.tmp && mv ~/.local/bin/.droid-models.tmp ~/.local/bin/droid-models
